old_source_closure.scope: Original native closure, coverage wrapper, BEGIN/FINISH/refit source closure; all additional actual inputs come from current study protocols.

checks: All original evaluator/shadow fields equal archived own-policy results
Eligible primary issue inventory and matured identities reconstructed from raw pre-action metadata
Every cue, closest processing midpoint and first legal tick selected independently
Every FINISH rank, margin, exact/version/payload correctness and pre-stage receipt history recomputed
Every marginal, matched transition, missing-status partition and three-seed mean/sample SD recomputed

matched.scope: Saved actual anchor fingerprints/quotas and scheduler exclusions, all raw sample fields, frozen affine scores, complete factorial/pair inventories and summary arithmetic. Recorded execution-equality flags are verified as saved assertions; the audit does not rerun world dynamics.

probe.scope: Every confusion/count/rate and cross-actor split; an independent late-stage augmented-SVD refit per seed. No world actions, model learning, threshold selection or new research.

transfer.scope: Every natural matured identity, available phase, raw/mapped label, actor fold, complete-three-stage population, score argmax, matched training-feature/label hash, confusion table and three-seed summary. Saved exact-replay flags/bindings checked; no new replay or readout fitting.

onset.scope: Exact original cue-state/score correspondence, unchanged request/treatment population, actual one-tick metadata and fixed BEGIN receipts, full non-input-state slices, every within-anchor propagation flag/distance and saved probe-confusion arithmetic. No dynamics replay or new probe fitting.

natural_probe.scope: Frozen source/data and continuous-feature bindings; whole-actor train/test populations, true-class denominators, training-only majority baseline, every saved confusion matrix's arithmetic and pooled accuracy/macro recall. Does not refit the natural calibration probe or establish policy use.

interpretation_limits: The three inherited training seeds are the independent replication units; requests, jobs, variants, families, phases and folds are nested observations.
Natural delayed scores may use the model's own attempted-action/result feedback and policy-dependent survival; they do not isolate passive memory retention.
Matched locked-BEGIN/WAIT forks isolate within-anchor raw-payload variation. Fixed version is repeated by the BEGIN receipt; this is not an isolated version-memory test.
Controlled duration changes preserve the actual scheduler and select uninterrupted windows; they do not describe a newly sampled natural task regime.
Actor lanes are held out only from the external action-head fitting, not from prior backbone training; probe actor folds keep each complete anchor's variants together.
Final deployed FINISH scores come from the externally supervised controller; probe or pair discrimination is not evidence of native port learning or autonomous complete behavior.

Immediate cue non-input states/scores are exactly invariant because each step flows first and then adds the pulse only on input nodes. The 25-percent balanced cue probe result is structural and does not establish failed cue encoding.
Stored controlled execution-equality assertions are source-reviewed and artifact-bound; this independent audit does not advance a world to reproduce them.
